MEANINGS.total_amplitude: Selected total reporter amplitude in direction-oriented native pixels.
MEANINGS.corrected_amplitude: Reporter amplitude retained under the selected baseline correction model.
MEANINGS.additional_amplitude: Additional reporter amplitude under the selected baseline correction model.
MEANINGS.retained_fraction: Corrected-to-total reporter amplitude ratio under the selected model.
MEANINGS.additional_fraction: Additional-to-total reporter amplitude ratio under the selected model.
MEANINGS.total_amplitude_variance: First-order variance of the total amplitude in the supplied joint estimate model.
MEANINGS.corrected_amplitude_variance: First-order variance of the corrected amplitude in the supplied joint estimate model.
MEANINGS.additional_amplitude_variance: First-order variance of the additional amplitude in the supplied joint estimate model.
MEANINGS.retained_fraction_variance: First-order variance of the retained fraction in the supplied joint estimate model.
MEANINGS.additional_fraction_variance: First-order variance of the additional fraction in the supplied joint estimate model.
